info.title: phpIPAM
info.description:
Authentication: API token in the token header. phpIPAM supports a static, admin-generated app code token (recommended — no login step, configured per API app under Administration → API) or a temporary token obtained via HTTP Basic login against /user/ (6-hour expiry).

phpIPAM is an open-source web IP address management application for tracking subnets, IP addresses, VLANs, and network devices.

Source: https://phpipam.net/api/api_documentation/

tokenAuth.name: token
tokenAuth.description: phpIPAM API token. Use a static app code token (App security = "SSL with App code token", phpIPAM 1.4+) so no separate login step is required. A dynamic session token obtained via POST /user/ also works but expires after 6 hours.

domainId.description: L2 domain ID. Defaults to 1 if omitted.
